Near midnight, a single distant light answered, blinking slowly through the rain: three flashes, then one, then three again.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台暂时停歇的机器。高架桥上偶有汽车掠过，轮胎声在空荡的楼群间拖得很长。便利店的白灯照着玻璃门，店员伏在柜台边打盹。远处写字楼还有几扇窗亮着，像没人熄灭的星。清洁车缓慢驶过路口，洒水在柏油路上留下微凉的光。天边尚未发白，风从河面吹来，带着潮湿的气味。一个早起的人提着豆浆走过斑马线，城市仍沉默，却已在黑暗里悄悄醒来。","w03":"- Recursion is when a set of instructions solves a problem by asking itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine finding the last book in a stack: move one book aside, ask the same question about the smaller stack, and stop when only one book remains.\n- Every recursive instruction needs a stopping rule, or it would keep asking itself forever."}
